This is the most DRC3a-relevant panel: it shows when papers begin treating oxygen access and energy conditions together.
Publication year in your oxygen literature table
• The list starts with clinical oxygen and pediatric respiratory evidence, then shifts after ~2020 toward oxygen systems, solar oxygen, oxygen security, and
• Geographically, sub-Saharan Africa dominates, with DRC-specific papers appearing as a smaller but strategically important thread: more
context/functionality/system evidence than classic patient-level trials.
• Solar/battery evidence becomes the main technical bridge between oxygen and energy; grid/generator detail is often present but still rarely measured as
voltage, outages, kWh, or diesel exposure.
• The strongest DRC3a gap is visible over time: the field increasingly knows oxygen is system-dependent, but far fewer papers measure electricity as a system
